Create a cohort of groups of the updated Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI)

Source: R/updatedCharlson.R
updatedCharlsonCohort.Rd

Usage

updatedCharlsonCohort(
  cdm,
  categories,
  name,
  ageAdjusted = TRUE,
  conceptSet = getIndexCodelist("updated_charlson"),
  subsetCohort = NULL,
  subsetCohortId = NULL
)

Arguments

cdm

A cdm_reference object.

categories

A named list of numeric vectors, each containing the lower and upper bounds of a score interval. Upper and lower bounds are both included. The name will be used to name the resultant cohort.

name

Name of the new cohort table created in the cdm object.

ageAdjusted

Logical; whether to include age adjustment in the updated Charlson Comorbidity Index.

conceptSet

A named concept set supplied as a codelist, codelist_with_details, concept_set_expression, or named list of concept IDs. It must contain congestive_heart_failure, dementia, chronic_pulmonary_disease, connective_tissue_disease, mild_liver_disease, hemiplegia, severe_chronic_kidney_disease, diabetes_with_complication, any_malignancy, moderate_or_severe_liver_disease, metastatic_solid_tumor, aids as concepts. By default, internal codelists are used.

subsetCohort

A character refering to a cohort table containing individuals for whom cohorts will be generated. Only individuals in this table will appear in the generated cohort. If NULL no subsetting will be performed.

subsetCohortId

Specifies cohort IDs from the subsetCohort table to include. If none are provided, all cohorts from the subsetCohort are included.

Value

A cohort table.

Details

The updated CCI is based on Quan et al. (2011) (doi:10.1093/aje/kwq433 ).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(omock)
library(duckdb)
library(OmopIndices)
library(dplyr)

cdm <- mockCdmFromDataset(datasetName = "GiBleed", source = "duckdb")

cdm$my_cohort <- updatedCharlsonCohort(
  cdm = cdm,
  categories = list(
    "none" = c(0, 0),
    "mild" = c(1, 2),
    "moderate" = c(3, 4),
    "severe" = c(5, Inf)
  ),
  name = "my_cohort"
)

cdm$my_cohort
settings(cdm$my_cohort)
} # }
